title: Two squares side by side
prompt: Draw a square of 30, then jump 40 forward, then draw another square of 30. Each square is four times: forward 30, turn left.
hints: After four left turns the turtle faces the way it started, so a jump moves it along.
Square, then `jump(40)`, then the square again.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line. Takes one number; returns nothing.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left. Give it a number to turn by a different angle.

solution:
func run():
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	jump(40)
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
	move_forward(30)
	turn_left()
